Definition: from G4253 and G2749; to lie before the view, i.e. (figuratively) to be present (to the mind), to stand forth (as an example or reward):--be first, set before (forth).
BiblicalUsage: Prokeimai means to lie before, to be set before the view. The writer to the Hebrews speaks of the hope set before us, and of Jesus who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that what lies before me shapes what I endure, and the joy set before Jesus carried him through the cross.
